description:
Install the git executable in the server image's runtime stage, so the containerized server keeps document history, diffs and reads at a commit once it reaches git through the CLI.

## Background

- The runtime stage installs `ca-certificates`, `ripgrep` and `wget` (`Dockerfile:32`) and no git. The server reads document history, diffs and documents at a commit through libgit2 linked into `jit-server`.
- The static contract suite `test-vectors/container-image/test_image_contract.py` (`StaticImageContractTests`) asserts the runtime stage's shape, and CI runs it (`.github/workflows/docker.yml:42`).
- The documented deployment maps the repository owner onto the container identity (`docs/how-to/deployment.md`), which git's repository ownership check requires.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The runtime stage installs the distribution's `git` package without recommended packages.
- [hard] REQ-02: A static contract test asserts that the runtime stage installs git, and fails against today's Dockerfile.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Server image ships the git executable
